dogecoin.text:
Back in 2013, my first ever crypto buy was $DOGE.

I sold most of it in 2017 during the crypto boom, making 15x in profit thinking it surely can't get better than this.

Fast forward to May 2021, and that initial $100 would’ve been worth $1.1M. 

Maybe the HODL gang was right.

@BeardoTrader Definitely how it feels.

I was thinking that the $TRUMP coin launch might have sparked retail to flood in like $DOGE did last cycle but after $MELANIA came out, we're cooked.
